cards.headline: Prism Johnson named preferred bidder for 45.21 MT Madhya Pradesh limestone block

issues.card_says: Years of limestone cover = 45.21 MT reserve / 6.6 MT FY25 cement volumes = 6.85 years
issues.pdf_says: Filing gives only the 45.21 MT reserve. Cement volume stands in for limestone use (limestone per tonne of cement differs from 1:1 and depends on clinker factor; part of Prism's volume is ground elsewhere). The card admits the proxy, and the arithmetic (6.85) is right. 'Years of cover' also ignores the company's existing mines.

cards.headline: IFB Industries Q1FY27: revenue ₹1,584.74 Cr (+18.4% YoY), net profit ₹43.05 Cr (+64.6% YoY)

issues.card_says: PBT 56.87 vs prev quarter 51.69, QoQ +10.0%; vs year-ago 36.51, YoY +55.8%
issues.pdf_says: Consolidated p7. 56.87 (Q1FY27) and 36.51 (Q1FY26) are profit before associate share and exceptional item. The Q4FY26 figure on that same line is 52.27; 51.69 is 52.27 less the 0.58 exceptional item. Like-for-like QoQ is +8.8%. The statement's own PBT is 57.20 vs 55.79 vs 35.04 (QoQ +2.5%, YoY +63.3%). issues.pdf_says: Memory has no trend to support this, and memory_refs is empty. Memory shows Q1FY26 ₹26.16 Cr was a weak base: Q1FY25 ₹37.54 Cr, Q2FY26 ₹50.79 Cr (above this quarter's ₹43.05 Cr). QoQ growth is only +0.9%.

issues.pdf_says: The meeting did run 11:00 a.m. to 5:55 p.m. (6.9 h). But the same filing reports PAT +64.6% YoY and higher margins, with no restructuring. The warning contradicts the results it sits on.
